definition.simple: How close the air near the ground is to being full of water vapour, measured from space at about 1:30 in the afternoon.
definition.scientific: AIRS/Aqua Level-3 monthly surface relative humidity, ascending (≈13:30 local) overpass, 1° grid.

note.simple: After 2021 the satellite flew over later in the day. We leave those years out.
note.scientific: Aqua ceased orbit maintenance in Jan 2022; the drifting overpass time biases the diurnal sampling.

definition.simple: How close the air near the ground is to being full of water vapour, measured from space at about 1:30 at night.
definition.scientific: AIRS/Aqua Level-3 monthly surface relative humidity, descending (≈01:30 local) overpass, 1° grid.

note.simple: After 2021 the satellite flew over later in the day. We leave those years out.
note.scientific: Aqua ceased orbit maintenance in Jan 2022; the drifting overpass time biases the diurnal sampling.

definition.simple: How warm the air near the ground is at about 1:30 in the afternoon, measured from space.
definition.scientific: AIRS/Aqua Level-3 monthly surface air temperature, ascending overpass, 1° grid.

note.simple: After 2021 the satellite flew over later in the day. We leave those years out.
note.scientific: Aqua ceased orbit maintenance in Jan 2022; the drifting overpass time biases the diurnal sampling.

reference_source: ≈0.2 °C per decade, global mean surface warming since the 1970s (NASA GISS)

definition.simple: How warm the air near the ground is at about 1:30 at night, measured from space.
definition.scientific: AIRS/Aqua Level-3 monthly surface air temperature, descending overpass, 1° grid.

note.simple: After 2021 the satellite flew over later in the day. We leave those years out.
note.scientific: Aqua ceased orbit maintenance in Jan 2022; the drifting overpass time biases the diurnal sampling.

reference_source: ≈0.2 °C per decade, global mean surface warming since the 1970s (NASA GISS)

definition.simple: How warm the air is 2 metres above the ground, worked out by a computer model that combines many measurements.
definition.scientific: MERRA-2 monthly mean 2-m air temperature, 0.5°×0.625° grid; a reanalysis, not an independent observation.

reference_source: ≈0.2 °C per decade, global mean surface warming since the 1970s (NASA GISS)

definition.simple: How much rain and snow falls, measured by satellites.
definition.scientific: GPM IMERG final monthly precipitation (V07), 0.1° grid; multi-satellite, gauge-adjusted.

definition.simple: How much rain falls, worked out by a computer model.
definition.scientific: MERRA-2 monthly bias-corrected total precipitation, 0.5°×0.625° grid.

definition.simple: How much water is in the top 10 cm of soil, worked out by a computer model.
definition.scientific: GLDAS-2.1 Noah monthly soil moisture content, 0–10 cm layer, 0.25° grid; model estimate.

units.simple: mm of water in the topsoil

note.simple: The computer model changed some of its input data in 2001.
The computer model changed some of its input data in 2008.
note.scientific: GLDAS-2.1 forcing change in 2008 (README_GLDAS2; month approximate).

note.simple: One of the model's inputs seems to shift after 2011.
note.scientific: Apparent shift in AGRMET forcing after 2011 (README_GLDAS2; month approximate).

note.simple: The computer model switched to a new input source in June 2025.
note.scientific: Switch to GALWEM forcing on 9 Jun 2025 (README_GLDAS2).

name.simple: Water rising from land and plants (computer model)

definition.simple: How much water goes up into the air from soil, lakes and plants, worked out by a computer model.
definition.scientific: GLDAS-2.1 Noah monthly evapotranspiration, 0.25° grid; model estimate.

note.simple: The computer model changed some of its input data in 2001.
The computer model changed some of its input data in 2008.
note.scientific: GLDAS-2.1 forcing change in 2008 (README_GLDAS2; month approximate).

note.simple: One of the model's inputs seems to shift after 2011.
note.scientific: Apparent shift in AGRMET forcing after 2011 (README_GLDAS2; month approximate).

note.simple: The computer model switched to a new input source in June 2025.
note.scientific: Switch to GALWEM forcing on 9 Jun 2025 (README_GLDAS2).

words.subject: the land
words.up: losing more water to the air
words.down: losing less water to the air

definition.simple: How much dust, smoke and pollution blocks sunlight. 0 is perfectly clear; 1 is very hazy.
definition.scientific: MODIS-Aqua Collection 6.1 monthly AOD at 550 nm, Dark Target + Deep Blue combined, 1° grid.

note.simple: Since 2022 the satellite flies over later in the day. Take those years with care.
note.scientific: Aqua ceased orbit maintenance in Jan 2022 (later overpass). AOD is kept (measured Aqua–Terra offset after 2022 ≈ 0.009); flagged, not cut.

kid_units.label: on a haze scale of 0 to 100

definition.simple: The same haze measurement from a second satellite, used to double-check.
definition.scientific: MODIS-Terra Collection 6.1 monthly AOD at 550 nm, Dark Target + Deep Blue combined, 1° grid.

note.simple: Since 2020 this satellite flies over earlier in the day. It is a weaker double-check after that.
note.scientific: Terra drifts to earlier equator-crossing times since its last inclination maneuver (27 Feb 2020); not a clean cross-check after 2020.

kid_units.label: on a haze scale of 0 to 100

name.scientific: Total aerosol extinction AOD at 550 nm (MERRA-2)

definition.simple: Haze worked out by a computer model. It uses the satellite data, so it is not a fully separate check.
definition.scientific: MERRA-2 monthly total aerosol extinction AOD; assimilates MODIS AOD, so not independent of it.

kid_units.label: on a haze scale of 0 to 100

name.simple: Pollution particles from burning coal and oil (computer model)

definition.simple: Tiny particles made mostly by power plants and industry, worked out by a computer model.
definition.scientific: MERRA-2 monthly surface SO₄ mass concentration.

words.subject: pollution from factories and power plants

definition.simple: Tiny particles that come mostly from fires and smoke, worked out by a computer model.
definition.scientific: MERRA-2 monthly surface organic carbon mass concentration.

definition.simple: A gas released by fires and engines, measured from space. It helps confirm smoke.
definition.scientific: MOPITT Level-3 monthly retrieved CO total column, daytime, 1° grid.

definition.simple: How warm the air is 2 metres above the ground, from NASA's POWER service for any place you pick.
definition.scientific: NASA POWER monthly T2M, area mean over the requested box; derived from MERRA-2.

reference_source: ≈0.2 °C per decade, global mean surface warming since the 1970s (NASA GISS)

definition.simple: How much rain falls, from NASA's POWER service for any place you pick.
definition.scientific: NASA POWER monthly PRECTOTCORR, area mean over the requested box; derived from MERRA-2.

definition.simple: How full of water vapour the air is near the ground, from NASA's POWER service for any place you pick.
definition.scientific: NASA POWER monthly RH2M, area mean over the requested box; derived from MERRA-2.
